verdict.rationale: Gmail's own documentation shows user-controlled deletion: the API permanently deletes drafts, Gemini can delete multiple emails, and the API lets you manage mailbox data such as messages and threads. Nothing in the evidence documents retention controls such as auto-delete schedules, retention periods, or deletion of AI/Gemini-processed data, so only the deletion half of the story is covered. missing for 10: retention policy/auto-delete schedule controls, documented permanent message deletion semantics, controls over retention of AI-processed data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Immediately and permanently deletes the specified draft.
Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
The Gmail API lets you view and manage Gmail mailbox data like threads, messages, and labels.
